dct_description_sm: Zambia administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 10 nan - Admin 2: 116 nan - Admin 3: 156 nan - Admin 4: 1853 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 29 June 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 26 November 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 26 November 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Disaster Management and Mitigation Unit (DMMU) Zambia
